panel.focus: preserve relational structure and negative evidence while moving between coarse and fine views
typed source closure, derivation identity, authority inheritance and erasure semantics
coarse-to-fine navigation without treating summaries as replacement evidence
DAG invariants, deterministic closure and explicit non-invertibility of lossy maps
multi-resolution exploration without collapsing alternate views
dangling lineage, stale derivations, false reconstructability and authority escalation

review_independence_note: Role-separated passes share one orchestration context and are not independent review.
blocking_invariants: canonical source records are never replaced by derived views
every derived view has explicit direct source IDs and pinned source hashes
transitive source closure terminates at canonical records or validation fails
cycles and dangling source references fail closed
lossy views declare an erasure ledger and may not be described as self-reconstructing
a pointer-backed lossy view may only claim source-rehydratability, not recovery of erased content from the view alone
a derived view cannot assert an authority class above the strongest authority licensed by all of its required source evidence under the declared authority order
registered contradiction sides and negative-history roots remain individually reachable from any view that claims to summarize them
regeneration/reconstruction is only claimed when an explicit witness has been externally verified; a transform name alone is not proof
input ordering does not change source closure or validation verdict

known_answer_worlds.name: canonical leaf
known_answer_worlds.condition: a canonical record has no derived-source dependency

known_answer_worlds.name: valid pointer-backed lossy view
known_answer_worlds.condition: lossy view pins all direct sources, declares erasures, and reaches canonical roots

known_answer_worlds.name: lossy view falsely claims self reconstruction
known_answer_worlds.condition: lossy view declares self-reconstructable without verified reconstruction witness

known_answer_worlds.name: dangling source
known_answer_worlds.condition: derived view references a missing source record

known_answer_worlds.name: stale source hash
known_answer_worlds.condition: pinned source hash differs from current immutable source record hash

known_answer_worlds.name: cycle
known_answer_worlds.condition: derived views form a source cycle

known_answer_worlds.name: transitive closure
known_answer_worlds.condition: multi-level view reaches every canonical leaf through complete transitive source closure

known_answer_worlds.name: authority escalation
known_answer_worlds.condition: derived view declares higher authority than a required source can support

known_answer_worlds.name: two-sided contradiction
known_answer_worlds.condition: coarse view over a contradiction preserves both source branches as reachable roots

known_answer_worlds.name: contradiction side silently dropped
known_answer_worlds.condition: view claims contradiction coverage but only one registered side is reachable

known_answer_worlds.name: verified exact regeneration
known_answer_worlds.condition: lossless derived view pins sources and carries an externally verified reconstruction witness

known_answer_worlds.name: transform label without witness
known_answer_worlds.condition: lossless view names a transform but has no verified reconstruction witness, so exact regeneration is not claimed

known_answer_worlds.name: negative-history root
known_answer_worlds.condition: a high-level current view retains a reachable refutation/failure source from earlier history

known_answer_worlds.name: permutation determinism
known_answer_worlds.condition: registry input permutation leaves validation and canonical source closure unchanged

falsifier: If simpler flat or hierarchical memory preserves the same source recall, negative history, contradiction coverage, downstream decisions and cost under matched tasks, the richer reconstructability layer must remain optional rather than mandatory.
authority_boundary: This benchmark can authorize only support-layer memory lineage/reconstruction metadata behavior. It cannot establish scientific truth, real-agent performance or global framework closure.
